The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Escalation is terminal: no monetary outcome issues, so there is nothing for POL-GEN-05 to execute and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded.

The judge's explanation, as written

To the rider and to the driver: this dispute cannot be settled on the record as it stands, so it goes to a human reviewer and no money moves now — the SGD 26.73 charged on TRP-02826 (EV-FARE-02826) is held rather than collected or refunded, and the SGD 11.00 contested is not awarded. What the evidence shows. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02826) records a METERED trip charged SGD 26.73: base fare 3.80 + distance 10.50 + time 5.32 + platform fee 0.80, with surge multiplier 1.0 read from that same artifact, and no ERP, no tolls, no airport surcharge and no waiting fee. The booked optimal route is 14.0 km (EV-TRIP-02826). The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02826) measures 18.2 km — an excess of 4.2 km, 30.0% of optimal — which would pass both POL-RD-01 tests (more than 20% and more than 0.8 km). Why the trace cannot carry that finding. The trace is impaired twice over. The admissibility pre-pass tagged it IMPAIRED at weight 0.6 with issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, and it is impaired for policy purposes too: it contains a 100.0-second gap between consecutive fixes (19:39:44 to 19:41:24), above the 90-second limit in POL-RD-07(a). Under POL-RD-07(ii) a deviation may not be established on an impaired trace alone and must be corroborated by an independent source. No weighted independent source exists here: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02826) holds 0 messages; the fare breakdown records no ERP gantries and 0.00 of tolls; and the 18.2 km on the trip record is, by POL-RD-01's own terms, a rounded convenience copy of the same trace measurement, not an independent derivation. The rider's submission that the driver's one-line statement 'Navigation rerouted me' is the 'counterparty_statement admitting the route' is not accepted: it names no road, junction or segment, it places the vehicle on no corridor the optimal route does not use, and it asserts a cause (the navigation) rather than admitting the route; the driver's contrary submission on that point succeeds. With the trace impaired under POL-RD-07(a) and no POL-RD-07(ii) corroboration, POL-RD-10(3) fires and the case escalates. The same result follows even if that statement were read as an admission. It carries no weight_multiplier and so cannot lift the confidence cap: the excess is carried only by the impaired trace at weight 0.6, so confidence cannot exceed 0.6, below the 0.70 floor, and POL-RD-10(1) would fire. Escalation is terminal either way and replaces any money outcome. The driver's navigation excuse. No advisory covers this window: EV-ADVIS-02826-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, no payload). POL-RD-03 cannot be run in either direction, and under POL-RD-13 the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08; because no advisory identifier was cited, the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. The rider's arithmetic, recorded but not awarded. Were the deviation established, POL-RD-02 would run: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 19.0) x the 1.0 surge on the fare breakdown + 0.80 = 20.42, giving a refund of 26.73 - 20.42 = 6.31, rounded up to SGD 6.35 — a PARTIAL_REFUND, above the 0.50 de minimis and at 23.6% of the charge well below the 90% full-refund share. I record that figure and do not award it. Nothing is added under POL-RD-09: there is no ERP, toll or surcharge line, so there is no double-count and no billing-integrity correction. No POL-RD-06 conduct referral arises: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 287 completed trips in 90 days, so no pattern is established, and the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter may not be substituted for it. What would resolve it. A POL-RD-07(ii) independent source — a driver admission in the chat log, an ERP gantry record placing the vehicle off the optimal corridor, or a trip_record.actual_distance_km derived independently of this trace — together with the traffic advisory for the disputed window, which the bundle lacks. This ruling is provisional; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04, or ask that a person decide the dispute. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

What each side argued

The rider advocate

kept The deviation is established on this trip's own trace. gps_trace.trace_distance_km is 18.2 km against a booked optimal of 14.0 km, an excess of 4.2 km — 30.0% of optimal — so both POL-RD-01 tests pass: the excess is greater than 20% of optimal_distance_km and greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms. POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure the governing field, so the same 18.2 km appearing on the trip record is not cited for the threshold test. Disclosure: the trace is impaired, weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, and the following claims deal with that impairment rather than hide it.

evidence EV-GPS-02826, EV-TRIP-02826 · clauses POL-RD-01

discarded The one impairment cannot absorb the excess. It is a single 100.0 s sampling gap (19:39:44 to 19:41:24) whose bounding fixes are 1.01 km apart, on a trace with 94.5% coverage, 174 fixes and 30.3 minutes of running. POL-RD-07(i) requires the impaired stretch to be read as the straight line between its bounding fixes — the reading most favourable to the driver — and a 1.01 km stretch cannot account for a 4.2 km excess. The gap changes how one stretch is measured; it does not change whether a deviation exists.

evidence EV-GPS-02826, EV-TRIP-02826 · clauses POL-RD-07, POL-RD-01

Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-02826 at weight_multiplier 0.6 but does not name its issue code(s): GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW

kept The impaired trace does not stand alone. POL-RD-07(ii) allows a deviation to be corroborated by a counterparty_statement admitting the route, and the driver's own statement on this dispute, filed by the DRIVER on 2026-08-19, is 'Navigation rerouted me.' That is the counterparty admitting the vehicle did not follow the planned route — an account independent of the trace, never withdrawn and never qualified. The rider does not rely on trip_record.actual_distance_km for this purpose, because POL-RD-01 identifies it as a rounded convenience copy of the same trace measurement and therefore not independent. The corroboration POL-RD-07(ii) requires is present, and the trace's impairment (weight 0.6, issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW) is cured by it.

evidence EV-TRIP-02826, EV-GPS-02826 · clauses POL-RD-07, POL-RD-08

kept No traffic advisory excuses the excess. POL-RD-03 exonerates only against a traffic_advisory that names a road or segment the optimal route traverses, carries a validity window overlapping the time the trace shows the vehicle reaching it, and is matched by a route that leaves the optimal corridor before the affected segment and rejoins it after. EV-ADVIS-02826-01 is MISSING — weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, no payload — and its own issue detail records that no advisory covers the Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd corridor in this window. The absence is itself citable: with no advisory on file the comparison cannot be run and POL-RD-03 is unavailable on this record.

evidence EV-ADVIS-02826-01, EV-TRIP-02826 · clauses POL-RD-03, POL-RD-13

discarded The driver's explanation discharges nothing. Once the rider has shown a threshold-meeting excess, POL-RD-08 puts the burden on the driver to point to a specific artifact and a specific clause; 'Navigation rerouted me' names no advisory, no road and no evidence ID, so it carries no weight. POL-RD-13 requires such an assertion to be tested against the traffic_advisory and nothing else, and because no advisory identifier is cited, the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction in it — so this is not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. The driver is left with an unexplained 4.2 km.

evidence EV-ADVIS-02826-01, EV-TRIP-02826 · clauses POL-RD-08, POL-RD-13, POL-RD-10

Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-ADVIS-02826-01 at weight_multiplier 0.0 but does not name its issue code(s): MISSING_ARTIFACT

kept No rider-caused detour can be made out. POL-RD-04 exonerates only to the extent of a rider instruction recorded in the chat_log, timestamped before the vehicle left the optimal corridor or no more than three minutes after, and specific enough to act on. The chat log for TRP-02826 is COMPLETE and contains 0 messages, and trip_record.chat_message_count is 0, so there is no instruction, no waypoint_hint and nothing to corroborate. The rider asked for no detour and accepts none of the excess.

evidence EV-CHAT-02826, EV-TRIP-02826 · clauses POL-RD-04

kept The baseline has not moved. pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null on the trip record, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are both null, so no re-quote under POL-RD-05 exists and none may be derived; the booked 14.0 km optimal route is the correct baseline against which the trace is measured.

evidence EV-TRIP-02826 · clauses POL-RD-05

kept The pooled-trip baseline does not apply. trip_record.vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline is not in play and measuring excess against the booked 14.0 km optimal is the correct field. The rider's claim does not fail on a wrong-field ground.

evidence EV-TRIP-02826 · clauses POL-RD-12

kept This is a metered trip, so the distance-refund route stays open. fare_breakdown.fare_model is METERED and fare_breakdown.quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply and POL-RD-02 governs the computation. The rider is not asking for money she never lost on a fixed price; she is asking for the difference between what was charged and what the optimal route costs.

evidence EV-FARE-02826 · clauses POL-RD-11, POL-RD-02

kept On POL-RD-02 the refund is arithmetic, not discretionary. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 19.0) x the surge_multiplier of 1.0 recorded on the fare_breakdown, plus the 0.80 platform fee, = 20.42; there is no ERP on the optimal route, no surcharge and no waiting-time fee to add. charged_total is 26.73, so the refund is 26.73 - 20.42 = 6.31, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 as 6.35. That is above the 0.50 de minimis floor, and at 23.6% of charged_total it is far below the 90% share that would convert it into a FULL_REFUND — so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 6.35 to the rider.

evidence EV-FARE-02826 · clauses POL-RD-02

kept No pass-through charge may be added on top. POL-RD-09(1) forbids stacking off-route ERP on the POL-RD-02 figure, and nothing is due in any event: erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp is 0.00 and airport_surcharge is 0.00 on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. The 6.35 is the distance and time difference alone, and no line of the ledger is counted twice.

evidence EV-FARE-02826, EV-TRIP-02826 · clauses POL-RD-09

(EV-GPS-02826 is impaired at weight 0.6, issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, and is cited here only for the excess it measures.)

evidence EV-RPROF-02826, EV-TRIP-02826, EV-GPS-02826, EV-FARE-02826 · clauses POL-RD-08

kept Only the profile counters the policy names may ground a finding. The rider seeks no finding from any profile field, and none of them decides this trip — the trace and the ledger do.

Judge

Who

model

What it produced

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs: 3 sampled drafts and one with the parties' positions swapped. The vote agreement is 1.0, and the outcome recorded is carried.

Each draft

  • draft 1 (sampled, sides DRIVER_ADVOCATE, RIDER_ADVOCATE): ESCALATE, amount none, driver none, confidence 0.6
  • draft 2 (sampled, sides DRIVER_ADVOCATE, RIDER_ADVOCATE): ESCALATE, amount none, driver none, confidence 0.6
  • draft 3 (sampled, sides DRIVER_ADVOCATE, RIDER_ADVOCATE): ESCALATE, amount none, driver none, confidence 0.6
  • draft 4 (position_swapped, sides RIDER_ADVOCATE, DRIVER_ADVOCATE): ESCALATE, amount none, driver none, confidence 0.6

Each draft's own explanation

To the rider and to the driver: this dispute cannot be settled on the record as it stands, so it goes to a human reviewer and no money moves now — the SGD 26.73 charged on TRP-02826 (EV-FARE-02826) is held rather than collected or refunded, and the SGD 11.00 contested is not awarded. What the evidence shows. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02826) records a METERED trip charged SGD 26.73: base fare 3.80 + distance 10.50 + time 5.32 + platform fee 0.80, with surge multiplier 1.0 read from that same artifact, and no ERP, no tolls, no airport surcharge and no waiting fee. The booked optimal route is 14.0 km (EV-TRIP-02826). The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02826) measures 18.2 km — an excess of 4.2 km, 30.0% of optimal — which would pass both POL-RD-01 tests (more than 20% and more than 0.8 km). Why the trace cannot carry that finding. The trace is impaired twice over. The admissibility pre-pass tagged it IMPAIRED at weight 0.6 with issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, and it is impaired for policy purposes too: it contains a 100.0-second gap between consecutive fixes (19:39:44 to 19:41:24), above the 90-second limit in POL-RD-07(a). Under POL-RD-07(ii) a deviation may not be established on an impaired trace alone and must be corroborated by an independent source. No weighted independent source exists here: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02826) holds 0 messages; the fare breakdown records no ERP gantries and 0.00 of tolls; and the 18.2 km on the trip record is, by POL-RD-01's own terms, a rounded convenience copy of the same trace measurement, not an independent derivation. The rider's submission that the driver's one-line statement 'Navigation rerouted me' is the 'counterparty_statement admitting the route' is not accepted: it names no road, junction or segment, it places the vehicle on no corridor the optimal route does not use, and it asserts a cause (the navigation) rather than admitting the route; the driver's contrary submission on that point succeeds. With the trace impaired under POL-RD-07(a) and no POL-RD-07(ii) corroboration, POL-RD-10(3) fires and the case escalates. The same result follows even if that statement were read as an admission. It carries no weight_multiplier and so cannot lift the confidence cap: the excess is carried only by the impaired trace at weight 0.6, so confidence cannot exceed 0.6, below the 0.70 floor, and POL-RD-10(1) would fire. Escalation is terminal either way and replaces any money outcome. The driver's navigation excuse. No advisory covers this window: EV-ADVIS-02826-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, no payload). POL-RD-03 cannot be run in either direction, and under POL-RD-13 the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08; because no advisory identifier was cited, the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. The rider's arithmetic, recorded but not awarded. Were the deviation established, POL-RD-02 would run: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 19.0) x the 1.0 surge on the fare breakdown + 0.80 = 20.42, giving a refund of 26.73 - 20.42 = 6.31, rounded up to SGD 6.35 — a PARTIAL_REFUND, above the 0.50 de minimis and at 23.6% of the charge well below the 90% full-refund share. I record that figure and do not award it. Nothing is added under POL-RD-09: there is no ERP, toll or surcharge line, so there is no double-count and no billing-integrity correction. No POL-RD-06 conduct referral arises: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 287 completed trips in 90 days, so no pattern is established, and the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter may not be substituted for it. What would resolve it. A POL-RD-07(ii) independent source — a driver admission in the chat log, an ERP gantry record placing the vehicle off the optimal corridor, or a trip_record.actual_distance_km derived independently of this trace — together with the traffic advisory for the disputed window, which the bundle lacks. This ruling is provisional; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04, or ask that a person decide the dispute.
To the rider and the driver: this dispute cannot be closed with a money order on the present record, so it goes to a human reviewer under POL-RD-10. Nothing is refunded and nothing further is collected — the SGD 26.73 already charged stands, and the SGD 11.00 contested is held rather than collected or refunded. What the record shows. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02826) is a METERED trip of 18.2 km billed at SGD 26.73, against a booked optimal of 14.0 km (EV-TRIP-02826). On those numbers the excess is 4.2 km, 30.0% of optimal, which would clear the POL-RD-01 gate (over 20% and over 0.8 km). Had the distance evidence held up, POL-RD-02 would recompute ((3.80 + 0.75 × 14.0 + 0.28 × 19.0) × 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee = 20.42, and refund 26.73 − 20.42 = 6.31, rounded up to SGD 6.35 — the figure the rider asks for. That refund cannot issue for the reason below. Why no refund can issue. The GPS trace EV-GPS-02826 is impaired, weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW: a 100-second sampling gap from 19:39:44 to 19:41:24 whose bounding fixes are 1.01 km apart. That breaches POL-RD-07(a) (over 90 seconds) and POL-RD-07(b) (over 500 m), so the trace is impaired for policy purposes as well as being flagged by the admissibility pre-pass — POL-GEN-02 says both things must be said, and they are. What the evidence shows. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02826) records a METERED trip charged SGD 26.73: base fare 3.80 + distance 10.50 + time 5.32 + platform fee 0.80, with surge multiplier 1.0 read from that same artifact, and no ERP, no tolls, no airport surcharge and no waiting fee. The booked optimal route is 14.0 km (EV-TRIP-02826). The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02826) measures 18.2 km — an excess of 4.2 km, 30.0% of optimal — which would pass both POL-RD-01 tests (more than 20% and more than 0.8 km). Why the trace cannot carry that finding. The trace is impaired twice over. The admissibility pre-pass tagged it IMPAIRED at weight 0.6 with issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, and it is impaired for policy purposes too: it contains a 100.0-second gap between consecutive fixes (19:39:44 to 19:41:24), above the 90-second limit in POL-RD-07(a). Under POL-RD-07(ii) a deviation may not be established on an impaired trace alone and must be corroborated by an independent source. No weighted independent source exists here: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02826) holds 0 messages; the fare breakdown records no ERP gantries and 0.00 of tolls; and the 18.2 km on the trip record is, by POL-RD-01's own terms, a rounded convenience copy of the same trace measurement, not an independent derivation. The rider's submission that the driver's one-line statement 'Navigation rerouted me' is the 'counterparty_statement admitting the route' is not accepted: it names no road, junction or segment, it places the vehicle on no corridor the optimal route does not use, and it asserts a cause (the navigation) rather than admitting the route; the driver's contrary submission on that point succeeds. With the trace impaired under POL-RD-07(a) and no POL-RD-07(ii) corroboration, POL-RD-10(3) fires and the case escalates. The same result follows even if that statement were read as an admission. It carries no weight_multiplier and so cannot lift the confidence cap: the excess is carried only by the impaired trace at weight 0.6, so confidence cannot exceed 0.6, below the 0.70 floor, and POL-RD-10(1) would fire. Escalation is terminal either way and replaces any money outcome. The driver's navigation excuse. No advisory covers this window: EV-ADVIS-02826-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, no payload). POL-RD-03 cannot be run in either direction, and under POL-RD-13 the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08; because no advisory identifier was cited, the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. The rider's arithmetic, recorded but not awarded. Were the deviation established, POL-RD-02 would run: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 19.0) x the 1.0 surge on the fare breakdown + 0.80 = 20.42, giving a refund of 26.73 - 20.42 = 6.31, rounded up to SGD 6.35 — a PARTIAL_REFUND, above the 0.50 de minimis and at 23.6% of the charge well below the 90% full-refund share. I record that figure and do not award it. Nothing is added under POL-RD-09: there is no ERP, toll or surcharge line, so there is no double-count and no billing-integrity correction. No POL-RD-06 conduct referral arises: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 287 completed trips in 90 days, so no pattern is established, and the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter may not be substituted for it. What would resolve it. A POL-RD-07(ii) independent source — a driver admission in the chat log, an ERP gantry record placing the vehicle off the optimal corridor, or a trip_record.actual_distance_km derived independently of this trace — together with the traffic advisory for the disputed window, which the bundle lacks. This ruling is provisional; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04, or ask that a person decide the dispute. On the fare breakdown's own figures that arithmetic gives charged_total 26.73 less a recomputed_fare of 20.42, i.e. 6.31 before rounding and 6.35 payable, which is well under 90% of the charged total. The 11.00 the rider contests is not supported by any line of the record and no FULL_REFUND is reached on any view. DISCARDED; The payment state is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00. Under POL-GEN-03 the two outcomes this record supports are party-relative and both leave the fare in place: NO_ACTION preserves fare_breakdown.payment_status and refund_issued_sgd exactly as they stand, and ESCALATE holds the disputed amount rather than collecting or refunding it. Only FULL_REFUND or PARTIAL_REFUND would take money out of the fare, and neither is available on an uncorroborated, impaired trace. KEPT; No billing-integrity or pass-through correction can be carved out of this fare on the rider's behalf. The fare breakdown reconciles to the 26.73 charged: erp_gantries is empty, tolls and ERP are 0.00, the airport surcharge line is 0.00, the platform fee is 0.80, and there is no charge line for a gantry the trace never crosses and no surcharge on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. There is nothing to refund under POL-RD-09(4), and no standalone pass-through correction exists to add to any distance refund. KEPT
